SELECT 
    s.signalregistry AS signal_id,
    s.centerfreqmhz AS central_frequency,
    s.freqdrifthzs AS drift_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000) AS numeric(20,10))) AS bandwidth_ratio,
    CASE 
        WHEN (s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000)) < 0.0001 
             AND s.freqdrifthzs < 0.1 
             AND sc.sigclasstype = 'Artificial' 
        THEN 'Strong NTM'
        WHEN (s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000)) < 0.0005 
             AND s.freqdrifthzs < 0.5 
             AND sc.sigclasstype = 'Artificial' 
        THEN 'Moderate NTM'
        ELSE 'Not NTM'
    END AS ntm_classification
FROM signals s
LEFT JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref
WHERE (s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000)) < 0.0005 
  AND s.freqdrifthzs < 0.5
ORDER BY bandwidth_ratio ASC;
